title: Seabridge Marina
specs: Located between Los Angeles and Santa Barbara
Cruise through Mandalay Bay to open water
Nearby Channel Islands offer camping, hiking, sightseeing, kayaking
Current registration/documentation or copy of bill of sale in applicant's name
Insurance policy naming Marina as additional insured with minimum $500,000 marine liability and hull coverage
Current color photograph of the vessel
Credit report required and will be run on applicant
Vessels older than 15 years or upon marina's discretion must provide survey within last 24 months
gap: Slip fees exact amounts not stated
blurb: Seabridge Marina is located between Los Angeles and Santa Barbara in Oxnard, California. It features landscaped parks, a children's playground, pedestrian bridges, and walkways adjacent to custom homes and a retail center. Guests can cruise through Mandalay Bay to open water and explore nearby Channel Islands.
extraNote: Deposit required prior to move in · First month's fees due for full month · Slip fees due on the first of every month · Key purchase $30 each, max 2 per boat · Parking permits $10 each · Written notice to vacate must be provided 30 days prior · Subletting of slip not permissible · No boat shall enter marina without prior inspection by marina · Slip fees based on boat or slip length, whichever is greater · Delinquent boats charged $2 per foot per day
